description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_Injector_DisplayLinkURI' which extends 'HTMLPurifier_Injector' and is responsible for displaying the URL of an anchor instead of creating a hyperlink, while also showing the link text.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_DisplayLinkURI
classes.description: An injector class that modifies anchor tags to display their URLs instead of linking.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an HTML element but currently has no implementation.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of an anchor element, replacing the href attribute with its URL in parentheses.
